g.text: With private parking added: a scenario for the corridor

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Blue: modelled automobiles (90 % interval). Orange: places of the legal curb at 5.5 m (upper bound). Green: curb plus one private place for

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: 72 % of the area's buildings of five dwellings or fewer, the share with a garage or driveway MEASURED on rue de Terrebonne (64–80 %).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: The cross streets were not read: for them this share is an assumption. Larger buildings are given no private place.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Corridor: 4,622 modelled automobiles; 6,755 curb places; 8,392 with the scenario's 1,637 private places (1,445–1,798).
